trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum: earn every other trophy in the base game, all 54 of them. Nothing online or DLC-related is required, so the entire grind happens offline in Leonida.
steps: Clear the story and all side content.
Track the remaining 54 trophies in this checklist.
Pop the last one and the platinum is yours.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing Gone Fishing, the mission that opens the game. Just play the opening and let it complete.
steps: Start the story and play Gone Fishing.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 1. Push through the opening chapter's missions, including Down to Earth and Feng Shui, and it unlocks at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing Chapter 2. Keep following the main mission thread and it lands automatically at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Completing Chapter 3 brings the story back to Vice City proper, and this trophy with it. Pure story progression, no side requirements.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: The Chapter 4 completion trophy. Stay on the main mission path and it pops when the chapter wraps.
steps: See the chapter through to its end.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold for finishing the campaign: complete No Better Place Than This, the final mission of Chapter 5. It is the last story beat, so just play to the credits.
steps: Complete No Better Place Than This.
Gold pops at the story's end.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run to earn this one. It sits on the main thread, so it comes naturally while working through the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist, one of the story's big set-piece robberies. Play the mission to its end and the trophy is automatic.
steps: See the heist through to completion.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play to unlock this story trophy. It is part of the main mission chain with no extra conditions.
steps: Reach Child's Play in the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Headliners. Keep pushing the Chapter 4 thread and this one lands when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown for this trophy. It is a late-story mission, so it arrives as part of the Chapter 5 run.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory and this one is yours. Another main-thread mission near the end of the campaign.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The 100% completion gold and the longest grind in the game. The checklist: 8 Bank Vaults and 39 Gang Operations robbed, gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, 42 Top Fun races won, 15 Target Decks cleared, 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. The fastest route is a district-by-district sweep: chain stunts, WAiNK scans and vault hits along one loop per region so every counter climbs without backtracking.
steps: Work the completion checklist category by category.
Use the in-game 100% tracker to find gaps.
Save the biggest grinds, stunts and scans, for last.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 of the 397 stunts scattered around Leonida. The pool breaks down into 130 jumps, 202 bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, so mix and match whichever types you enjoy. The fastest route to 250 is farming the 202 bridge stunts in dense clusters with a fast car, then topping up with the nearest jumps — you can skip knife flights and base jumps entirely.
steps: Pick stunt types you like; jumps and bridges are the biggest pools.
Use a fast vehicle for gaps and a plane for knife flights.
Track progress toward 250; you do not need all 397.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the game's 9 activity types at least once. You do not need to win or master any of them; a single attempt at every category is enough.
steps: List the 9 activity types from the map legend.
Do one run of each, wins optional.
Check the trophy after the last new type.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge, all 42 of them spread across 12 ranges. Each challenge demands speed and accuracy, so replay until every score is gold.
steps: Replay each challenge until it scores gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. One win per spot is enough; you do not need to sweep every race at a location.
steps: Find all 14 Top Fun drone race spots.
Win at least one race at each.
Tick locations off as you go.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 of the 40 races on offer. Pick the events you are strongest at and farm wins there rather than spreading yourself thin across every class.
steps: Focus on your best vehicle class.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal at fishing. The challenge opens up after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, so head out with Cal once it is available and out-fish him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game; any of Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck counts. Pick the cabinet you are best at and play it to completion.
steps: Play one of the four games to its end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's strand. Follow his stranger missions to the end and the trophy lands with the last one.
steps: Start Andy's strand when you meet him.
Complete every mission in his chain.
Finish his finale for the trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission. His strand plays out across the state, so keep taking his calls and see it through to the last job.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's last mission. Stay on his strand until it concludes and this trophy comes with the finale.
steps: Find Billy and start his missions.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Named contacts like Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each count, so finish full strands rather than one-off jobs.
steps: Finish each strand to its final mission.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Keep his strand moving and the trophy unlocks when his last job is done.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission. See his strand through to the end; the trophy is tied to that last completion.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida until the counter hits 18, and both characters' meditations count toward it. The one trap: Lucia's balcony meditation after Down to Earth in Chapter 1 is missable, so do it before moving the story on.
steps: Do Lucia's balcony meditation right after Down to Earth (Ch.1).
Meditate at every spot you find with either character.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take on his hunting job and bring down the specific animal he asks for; a regular kill will not do.
steps: Meet Bret and take his hunt.
Track the unique animal he names.
Complete the hunt for the trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across the state, so sweep areas methodically and finish three full sets rather than dabbling in all of them.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 points of interest. The pool includes 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags, so scan whatever you pass and keep a running tally. The fastest route is sweeping the 31 landmarks and 35 curiosities first since they cluster in town, then the 23 sculptures, and topping up with No Flusher tags until the counter hits 100.
steps: Scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures with WAiNK.
Do not skip the No Flusher tags.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges in the game. You can skip the ones you hate; just keep knocking out challenges until the count reaches 50.
steps: Progress carries across all challenge types.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Get the law fully riled up while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars fade.
steps: Cause chaos with your partner until 4 stars.
Flee together and hide out of sight.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Keep the heat alive between hits: route three stores close together and move fast.
trophies.planning: Run it with your partner: pick three stores on one block, keep the car idling at the curb, and move between hits fast enough that the wanted level never drops.
steps: Plan a route of 3 nearby shops.
Rob them in a row with your partner.
Do not let the wanted level drop mid-run.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Log new models as you explore; traffic variety, parked cars and mission vehicles all feed the discovery count.
steps: Scan vehicles you have not logged.
Explore different districts for new traffic.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Find a dense firefight, like gang turf or a heist gone loud, and chain five kills before the focus ends.
steps: Save Combat Focus for a crowded fight.
Line up 5 targets in one activation.
Drop all five before it expires.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. When the story puts you at the agency, look for a way out that is not the planned one; the trophy rewards improvising your exit.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos: this one is about the Rhino tank. Get hands-on with a Rhino when you encounter one and deal with the tank directly; the trophy follows the encounter.
steps: Find a Rhino in the wild.
Engage with it instead of driving past.
The trophy pops off the encounter.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, stay out of sight lines and grab the goods before anyone raises the alarm; stealth is the whole condition.
trophies.planning: Go in solo after dark, enter from the rear while the clerk faces the counter, and slip out the same way before the alarm ever trips.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape with the take. Each vault counts only if you get away, so plan exits and lose the heat after every hit.
trophies.planning: Bring your partner to watch the lobby, park a fast car facing the exit, and lose the heat in a nearby alley after each vault so every hit counts.
steps: Hit bank vaults across the state.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Stop the truck, take the cash and get clear of the response; the escape is part of the condition.
trophies.planning: Box the truck in on a quiet street with your partner covering the guards, then take the cash and escape down a side road before the response arrives.
steps: Escape the heat to pop it.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Push into every region of the map until the whole state is uncovered; road trips off the beaten path count as much as city driving.
steps: Check the map for unexplored patches.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Every gang runs rackets around the state, so hit at least one operation per gang until you have touched them all.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, find the spot with the view and order the drink; a small scene, not a grind.
steps: Find the cocktail spot with the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Get behind the wheel of a showroom car and drive it out through the glass instead of the door.
steps: Take a car for an unsanctioned test drive.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Head to their alley and play a game of bowling; the trophy is in the follow-through.
steps: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This one lands during a partner moment built for an audience, so keep playing story and side content with your partner and it comes naturally.
steps: Keep your partner close in story and activities.
Watch for the big partnership moment.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. The game tracks the decisions you make along the way, so play missions and conversations your way and the count takes care of itself.
steps: Make choices in missions and dialogue.
Do not reload to optimize outcomes.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail at something, then come back and succeed on the retry; the trophy rewards the comeback rather than the first attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange out in Leonida; keep your eyes on the sky and the weird corners of the state and let the oddity find you.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and knock someone down; timing and a slow pass make it easier.
steps: Arm a melee weapon in a vehicle.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Dirty cash comes from robberies, so keep feeding Marked Bills to your laundering contacts until the earnings hit $250k.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothes, weapons, vehicles, mods: every purchase counts, so spend freely as the cash rolls in.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Garages come up for sale around the state; buy every one of them to complete the set.
steps: Find garages for sale on the map.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Spot vehicles around the state and log them through the app; ten registrations does it.
